name: Dragon Adventures
notes: Dragon Adventures 0.9.0-r3: review fix on rejected 0.9.0. Chunky grey rock gems bounce out, sit at least 20s, and magnet-collect with a +1 rock piece toast — autosave never vacuums them. Rocks show crack stages before they break. Burning trees have large flame tongues, glow, smoke, and char over 6–8s, then a stump with embers and a sapling. Monsters catch fire 4–6m ahead, flee with flames, poof in a sparkle burst, and drop bigger spinning coins. Sitting looks out from the bench at seated eye height. Camp cushions use fabric colours; forest wild dragons are russet. Flight 3× walk, schema v5, IDB/cacheId/test-* denylist unchanged. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
